findings.text: The delegation to the owner's percentile_or_none has no test that reddens if a local nearest-rank body returns to this script: grep over tests/ and imas_ambix/ finds no reference to bound_seeds at all, and the two estimators are numerically identical, so no figure-drift check can catch the regression either. The reuse repair can therefore be undone silently; its only guard is the manual reuse negative control.

The logged green arm of the reuse negative control (reuse-negative-control.log, the manifest's declared negative_control_log) interleaves uv's 'Provide a command or script to invoke' help listing between its '# command:' header and the script's pass line, so the green arm's provenance cannot be read from that log alone. The essential negative-control fact is unaffected — the pre-repair arm is clean and ends EXIT=1 — and check-green.log is a clean EXIT=0 at the repaired tree.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against the base: one commit, one file, +7/-9 — it deletes _rank_p90, imports percentile_or_none from imas_ambix/agent/lane_utilisation.py and calls it at bound_seeds.py:52, adds the estimator paragraph to the module docstring, and corrects the usage line to 'check <log> <fragment>'.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done-when's measures hold at the reviewed head: logs/s5-ten-seeds.log carries ten seeds × both arms plus the think-time-drop run in both arms (seed 0 34.50 bounded against 47.00 bound-disabled, think_drop 16.00 in both arms); check-green.log ends EXIT=0; s12.html states 16.0 s; the gained commit regenerates the log byte-identical (data lines identical to the committed log).
